hero.title: Get In Touch
hero.subtitle: Have a project in mind? Let's talk about how we can help bring your ideas to life.

location.title: Our Location
location.subtitle: Find us at our office — we'd love to host a meeting.

questions.q: What is your typical project timeline?
questions.a: Project timelines vary based on complexity. Simple websites take 1-2 weeks, while complex applications can take 2-3 months. We provide detailed timelines after understanding your requirements.

questions.q: Do you provide ongoing support after delivery?
questions.a: Yes! We offer maintenance and support packages to ensure your website or application runs smoothly. We provide bug fixes, updates, and feature enhancements.

questions.q: What payment terms do you offer?
questions.a: We typically require 50% advance payment to start the project and 50% upon completion. For larger projects, we can arrange a payment schedule.

questions.q: Can you help with hosting and deployment?
questions.a: Absolutely! We handle deployment to platforms like Vercel, Railway, AWS, and more. We also help with domain setup and SSL certificates.
